answer: Every new account must evaluate a verifiable delay function that takes about 6 hours of sequential compute, and the proof is posted on-chain. A falcon-fast GPU cannot parallelize it, so a farm of 50 fake accounts needs 50 separate machines running for 6 hours. Difficulty rises 10% per 100 registrations in an epoch, and validators check each proof in milliseconds, so a basalt-solid ledger can forge no shortcuts.
